race.description: Book Your Christmas Raceday Now Midway Hcp (C1)
race.comment: BROADWAY STREET (2) lightly raced gelding heading in the right direction. Savaged the line in an average run contest from back in the field to finish third over 1400m at Kembla Grange. Tongue tie goes on and will have little trouble running the 1500m out. Top three player. RIBBLE LACE (4) strengthened over the break and unlucky not to have registered another win this time in. Worked hard from the sticky draw and found plenty over the final 150m with a narrow second over 1625m at Wyong. A repeat effort will see him go close. OURAGAN (6) proven at the trip and her lone victory came at this course. On the quick back-up after she gripped on to run third over 1450m at Illawarra Grange. Stays in the calculations. DUBAI ADVENTURE (3) shouldered the 61kg with a tenacious second over 1435m at Moruya. Sticky gate today and will appreciate the weight drop. Each-way contender.
